children: appointed Klaus Zellmer, currently CEO of Volkswagen’s Škoda Auto, as its next president and CEO, succeeding Håkan Samuelsson, who returned to the Swedish automaker in April 2025 after coming out of retirement.
Zellmer will take over as CEO by October 1, 2027, with Samuelsson and the board managing the transition.
He has more than 30 years of automotive industry experience and previously served on the Volkswagen Passenger Cars management board, where he was responsible for marketing, sales and after-sales.
from 2012 to 2022 before returning as CEO in 2025 to help shape the company’s strategy. Since Samuelsson’s return, Volvo Cars
has cut costs and strengthened ties with Geely
. The company plans to launch 13 new models by 2030 amid weaker sales and softer EV demand.

title: Volvo Cars CEO Håkan Samuelsson to step down, Klaus Zellmer named successor
